description: Defines an abstract class DataLabelRenderer responsible for rendering data labels within charting components of the PDFsharp library. Contains initialization logic and an abstract method for position calculation.

classes.name: DataLabelRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class that provides base functionality for rendering data labels in charts, including initialization of label info and an abstract method for position calculation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the data label rendering information based on chart and series properties, setting defaults and converting styles as needed.
